## A Private Experience, Not Just a Photoshoot

This isn’t a group tour with a camera pointed at you for two minutes. It’s a private session, built around you — your comfort, your pace, your story.

You don’t come out with a set of vacation pictures. You come out with images that actually look like you, taken in one of the most striking natural settings in Mexico.

## Choose your experience

### More than one way to experience the Riviera Maya:  
 from underwater cenotes, to the beach, each session is designed around the environment, the light and the person in front of my camera.

## Underwater Photoshoot

![Image 13](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/UNDERWATER-Cenote-Photoshoot-Riviera-Maya-Emilia-Black-Box-703x1024.jpg)

Private underwater portraits inside a cenote, fully submerged, using natural light filtering through the water. This is the signature experience — the one most people come to me for.

[Explore](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

## Cenote Jungle Photoshoot

![Image 14](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/best-photographer-in-playa-del-carmen-683x1024.jpg)

For those who love the cenote atmosphere but prefer to stay above the water. Portraits at the surface, half-in half-out, or surrounded by jungle — same artistic result, without going fully underwater.

[Explore](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/cenote-photoshoot/)

## Diving Photography

![Image 15](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/scuba-diving-photography-playa-del-carmen-683x1024.jpg)

Professional photography during your dive, in the open sea or in a cenote. I document the moments you can’t see from above — your movement, the marine life, the light.

[Explore](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/scuba-diving/)

Relaxed portraits by the Caribbean Sea in Playa del Carmen. Couple sessions, solo portraits, editorial-style photography — no water required.

[Explore](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/beach-photoshoot-playa-del-carmen/)

## First time underwater ?

![Image 17](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/cenote-photoshoot-732x1024.jpg)

You don’t need any previous experience.

If you’ve never done an underwater photoshoot before, you don’t have to know how to pose, hold your breath or move underwater.

I guide you step by step through breathing, body position, movement and posing, so you can gradually feel comfortable in the water while I focus on creating the images.

Because the session is private, there’s no group to keep up with and no pressure to get everything right on the first try.

**NO EXPERIENCE NEEDED**  
**FULLY GUIDED**  
**PRIVATE SESSION**

[EXPLORE THE UNDERWATER EXPERIENCE](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

## What makes this experience different?

Private, calm, and planned around the cenote.

Every session is private and planned around the natural conditions of the cenote — including light, water clarity and timing.

There’s no group to follow and no need to rush from one setup to another. We work at a pace that allows you to relax, adjust and make the most of the environment.

**PRIVATE SESSION**  
**NATURAL LIGHT & WATER CONDITIONS**  
**PERSONALIZED GUIDANCE**

![Image 18](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/UNDERWATER-PORTRAITS-IN.CENOTE-4DRADO-1024x1024.jpg)

## How it works?

*   Choose your date  
We select the best day based on availability and conditions.

*   Get prepared  
I’ll guide you before the session on what to bring, what to wear, and what to expect.

*   The photoshoot  
During the session, I guide you step by step in the water so you can feel comfortable and move naturally.

*   Receive your images  
After the session, you’ll receive a curated selection of professionally edited photos.

# Underwater photoshoot experience in Cenotes:  
 Tulum & Playa del Carmen

Private underwater sessions for individuals and couples, designed for all levels — even if you have no previous experience.

Each photoshoot is fully guided and adapted to your comfort in the water, combining artistic direction, natural light, and carefully selected cenotes to create powerful, high-end images.

## What to expect?

![Image 2](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/cenote-photoshoot-768x1075.jpg)

We’ll meet at a cenote located between Playa del Carmen and Tulum early in the morning, when the light conditions are at their best.

Before entering the water, I’ll guide you through breathing techniques and simple underwater movements so you feel comfortable and in control. No modeling or diving experience is required.

The session lasts approximately 2 hours. We’ll work with one or two outfits depending on the package, taking short breaks between sets to rest and warm up.

Throughout the session, I guide you step by step to create natural, elegant images — focusing on movement, posture and light.

## Why I Choose Cenotes?

Cenotes offer consistently clear visibility, calm water with no current, and natural conditions that make the experience accessible even if it’s your first time.

Unlike the ocean, there are no waves or unpredictability — allowing you to relax, control your movements and focus on creating strong, natural images.

Each cenote has its own unique scenery: light beams cutting through the water, rock formations, mangroves and open jungle surroundings that create a setting impossible to replicate anywhere else.

Because of these conditions, every session feels different while still offering a controlled and comfortable environment.

## F.A.Q.

##### Frequently Asked Questions

[SAFETY & EXPERIENCE](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

[Do I need to know how to swim to do an underwater photoshoot?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

You don’t need to be a strong swimmer. We stay in calm, shallow areas of the cenote, and I guide you through the entire session.

[Is it safe to do a cenote photoshoot if I've never done anything underwater before?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

Yes. Cenotes have calm, still water with no waves or currents, unlike the ocean — which makes them ideal for a first-time underwater experience. With 8 years of experience guiding people through their very first underwater session, I make sure you feel in control the whole time.

[Can I do an underwater photoshoot if I'm pregnant?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

Absolutely. Being in the water won’t affect your baby. We’ll make sure you feel comfortable and safe throughout, and take breaks if you feel cold.

[For how long do I need to hold my breath?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

Just a few seconds is enough to get a great photo.

[What happens if I wear contact lenses?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

I recommend removing them before the session, since it’s common to lose them underwater. If you’d rather keep them in, that’s fine too — just bring a spare pair in case they fall out.

[PLANNING YOUR SESSION](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

[Where is the cenote located?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

The cenote is located between Playa del Carmen and Tulum, 20 minutes each way.

[What time does the photoshoot start, and why so early?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

Sessions start early in the morning, around 8–8:30 am. That’s when the light inside the cenote is at its best, and when there’s practically no one else around.

[Does the price include transportation?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

No, transportation isn’t included. If you have your own car, I’ll send you the exact location to meet at the entrance. If not, local buses from Playa del Carmen and Tulum drop you right at the cenote entrance. If you’re staying in Playa del Carmen, I can also arrange a trusted taxi for an extra fee.

[Can I book a session alone, as a couple, or with a group?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

Solo and couple sessions are both available, from 1 to 2 people depending on the package. If you’re a group of 3 or more (like a bachelorette or birthday celebration), reach out and I’ll let you know what’s possible

[Do you speak English?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

Yes! I speak English fluently, so you can communicate with me comfortably throughout the entire experience. I’ll guide you through everything, from posing and breathing techniques to the photoshoot itself.

[DURING THE SESSION](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

[What about the outfit — do I need to bring my own?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

I have a selection of fabrics, skirts and dresses available for the session. You’re also welcome to bring your own outfit — I’ll guide you beforehand to make sure it works well with the cenote environment.

[Are all the photos taken fully underwater?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

That’s completely up to you. We can shoot the whole session underwater, or mix in some photos above the water with your head out. Cenotes have beautiful light and atmosphere both in and out of the water.

[Do you take care of the photo editing?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

Yes. Underwater photos are more complex to edit due to light and color, and it’s something I pay close attention to — I love working with color and lighting to get the final result right.

[AFTER YOUR SESSION](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

[Can I have more photos that the ones included?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

Of course! You can select more photos for 300 mx pesos each.

[Who selects the final photos — you or me?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/underwater-photoshoot-in-cenotes/)

Either way works. Some clients prefer to leave the selection to me, and others like to choose themselves. If you’d rather choose, I’ll send you all the unedited, watermarked photos within 2 days of the session so you can pick your favorites.

# Cenote Photoshoot  
Tulum & Playa del carmen

Experience a cenote photoshoot designed for those who want the atmosphere of the cenote without necessarily being fully underwater.

Sessions can take place at the water’s surface, half in/ half out, or in the surrounding jungle — always guided and adapted to your comfort.

## This experience is for you if:

*   You love the cenote environment but don’t necessarily want to be fully underwater

*   You feel more comfortable staying above water or working at the surface

*   You are looking for natural, artistic images without forced posing

*   You want a mix of water, light and jungle in the same session

*   You prefer a slower, more relaxed experience

[BOOK YOUR PHOTOSHOOT](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/contact/)

![Image 2: a beautiful brunette girl is sitting in the water of a cenote in profile, leaning on one of her arms](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Cenote-Photoshoot-in-Tulum-683x1024.jpg)

## What makes this different?

This is not an underwater photoshoot.

The entire session takes place above the water or at the surface, combining natural movement in shallow areas, half-water portraits and moments in the surrounding jungle.

Because you are never fully submerged, the experience feels more relaxed, accessible and easier to enjoy from the beginning.

The focus is on creating natural, powerful images while staying connected to the environment — without the physical demands of a full underwater session.

![Image 3](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/CENOTE-PORTRAIT-PHOTOSHOOT-768x1023.jpg)

![Image 4](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/CENOTE-PHOTOSHOOT-IN-TULUM-768x1023.jpg)

## How this photoshoot works?

We meet at the cenote early in the morning, when the light is softer and the space is quieter.

Before starting, I guide you through simple positioning and movement so you feel comfortable in front of the camera.

We begin with the easiest part of the session — usually above water or at the surface — and gradually explore different areas depending on your comfort level.

The session flows naturally between water and land, without rushing, allowing you to relax and enjoy the environment.

## F.A.Q.

##### Frequently Asked Questions

[Where is the cenote located?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/cenote-photoshoot/)

The cenote is located between Playa del Carmen and Tulum, 20 minutes each way.

[Will I be underwater at any point?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/cenote-photoshoot/)

No. This session is designed to stay above water or at the surface only. If you’re looking for fully underwater images, that’s a different experience.

[What should I wear?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/cenote-photoshoot/)

I’ll guide you before the session, but for cenote photoshoots, earthy tones tend to work beautifully with the natural surroundings.

Subtle details like shine, metallic elements or pearls can also add a nice contrast and catch the light in a unique way.

I usually recommend solid colors, so the focus stays on the cenote and the overall atmosphere rather than busy patterns.

[What time photoshoot begin?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/cenote-photoshoot/)

Underwater photo sessions start early in the morning (8-9 am max).  
The reason is the quality of the morning light and that at that time there are practically no people

[The price includes transportation?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/cenote-photoshoot/)

The transportation is not included. If you have your own car I will send you the location and we are gonna meet in the entrance. Otherwise you have local buses leaving from Playa del Carmen and Tulum that leave you at cenote entrance.

In case you are located in PDC I can organice a trusted taxi for you with an extra fee.

[You take care of the edition?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/cenote-photoshoot/)

Yes! Underwater photos are more difficult to edit due to several factors. But I am quite detailed at this point and I love working with colors and lighting.

[Can I have more photos that the ones included?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/cenote-photoshoot/)

Of course! You can select more photos for 350 mx pesos each.

[What about the selection of the photos?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/cenote-photoshoot/)

Some people prefer to leave that job to me and I take care of the selection and others prefer to do it themselves. In this last case, in the 2 days after the photo session I will send you all the photos (unedited and with watermark) so that you can make your selection.

[What is the booking policy?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/cenote-photoshoot/)

A 30% deposit is required to secure your date. The remaining balance is paid on the day of the session, after the photoshoot.

Cancellations must be made at least 48 hours in advance to receive a full refund of the deposit.

If cancelled with less than 48 hours’ notice, the deposit is non-refundable but can be applied to a rescheduled session.

In case of heavy rain or unsafe conditions, the session will be rescheduled.

[How soon you deliver the photos and in what way?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/cenote-photoshoot/)

It usually takes me between 7 and 10 days. You’ll receive a private online gallery via email, where you can view and download your selected images

[How far in advance should I need to book?](https://emilia-uwphoto.com/cenote-photoshoot/)

It depends a lot on the season. Preferably 1 week before. In case of availability, I take reservations 48 hours in advance to make sure I have everything organized. If you have any question or if you are ready to book a session, contact me through this website or whatsapp. We will find a date that both suit us.
